text: {"lessons":["A gain versus my average cost is not, by itself, a reason to sell; I should judge each trade by its expected contribution to the whole portfolio.","Treating stocks as separate accounts and focusing on whether each is above or below my purchase price can distort decisions; I should consider current prices and future prospects instead.","When past price changes do not predict future moves, holding without a clear reason is no better than reacting to recent losses; I should make deliberate, forward-looking decisions rather than avoid admitting a mistake."]}
